More private, behind-the-scenes organizing is more effective than public adversarial approaches with a business community.
briefs.positioning_implication: Assess movement strategies based on participation, defections, method adaptability, and resilience to identify potentially impactful interventions.  Target vulnerable pillars with informed strategies for efficiency.
